message.text: Identifying the server push mechanism, hub implementation location, and memo handlers that broadcast live events to browsers.
UpdateMemo likely broadcasts through memo_update_helpers. Other memo-related handlers such as the attachment and relation services may also broadcast through the hub.
Reading `memo_update_helpers` to identify which handler calls `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`.

Checking memo_service.go and related files for the exact handler names that broadcast live events.

CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, and DeleteMemo broadcast in memo_service.go. CreateMemoComment broadcasts in memo_service_comments.go. SetMemoAttachments and SetMemoRelations broadcast in memo_attachment_service.go and memo_relation_service.go. Reaction service handlers are still being verified.

Determining whether "memo handlers" refers to MemoService handlers or any handler broadcasting memo events. Reaction handlers are part of MemoService per proto.

The server uses Server-Sent Events (SSE) over text/event-stream. The endpoint is /api/v1/sse.

The hub is implemented in server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go. Handlers that broadcast directly include CreateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, UpsertMemoReaction, and DeleteMemoReaction. UpdateMemo, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations broadcast indirectly via dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects.

q20.

SSE (Server-Sent Events); server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go; CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, UpsertMemoReaction, DeleteMemoReaction

Live updates use **SSE**: clients connect to `/api/v1/sse` with `Content-Type: text/event-stream` (`server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go`, registered from `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`).

The hub is **`SSEHub`** in `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` (`Subscribe`, `Unsubscribe`, `Broadcast`).

**Memo handlers that broadcast:**

| Handler | File | Event |
|---|---|---|
| `CreateMemo` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | `memo.created` |
| `UpdateMemo` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | `memo.updated` (via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` in `memo_update_helpers.go`) |
| `DeleteMemo` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | `memo.deleted` |
| `CreateMemoComment` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` | `memo.comment.created` |
| `SetMemoAttachments` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go` | `memo.updated` (via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`) |
| `SetMemoRelations` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go` | `memo.updated` (via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`) |
| `UpsertMemoReaction` | `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go` | `reaction.upserted` |
| `DeleteMemoReaction` | `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go` | `reaction.deleted` |
